name: Salt Flat Venom
statusNote: Unchanged in Forever as far as is known: the text, objectives and rewards below are Classic’s.
footerSourceNote: Text, givers, objectives and rewards come from the cMaNGOS Classic database (a reconstruction of the 1.12 world), with what Forever changed on top: the game server’s own answers where we have them, else Wowhead’s Forever database. Places are Classic’s, shown on the Forever maps. Quest text © Blizzard Entertainment.

narrative.details:
I have so many designs for our rocket car!  So many!  And I must try them all!!

I'm working on a new type of fuel.  One that burns really really really hot!!  I haven't gotten the mixture perfect, but I think I know what I need...

The scorpids who wander the Shimmering Flats have a venom with lots and lots of salt in it.  It's very unique!  And it's just what I need!

Bring me venom and trust me -- our car will fly!!
narrative.objectives: Bring 6 Salty Scorpid Venoms to Fizzle Brassbolts in the Shimmering Flats.
narrative.offerRewardText:
All right! This venom is going to work great! Thanks, adventurer!

Now I just need to boil it down, apply skipper-otomer, add a nega-catalyst, and... Drat! Where are my notes!?
narrative.requestItemsText: Hi hi hi! Did you get that venom??
